_about: A criterion KIND proposed into #130's closed vocabulary (move-use | state | held | command) — the vocabulary edit lands only in #130's file, citing #175. Not a new forme axis: #130's formFamily, delta discipline, presentation hook, and dex rules are untouched. Zero families instanced; zero deltas asserted.

criterion_kind.direction: reversible — by construction (a weather family does not get persistAfterBattle; persistence would contradict the criterion)
criterion_kind.weatherState: one of CLEAR | OVERCAST | RAIN | STORM | MIST | FROST — #61's vocabulary MINUS NONE

depths_clause: NONE is excluded from the input alphabet (a criterion naming NONE is a schema error — NONE means the weather system is OFF, and a forme cannot trigger on a system being off). The Dark Forest depths are weather NONE (#61/#142), therefore no weather forme can trigger there — a property of the alphabet, not an exception table; any future NONE place is covered with no new rules.
evaluation: pure function of (family rule, current effective weather) at read time — effective weather = #61 producer output filtered through #142 climate. Battle entry value computed from weather at battle start; re-evaluated on mid-battle weather change (the forme follows the state, never latches). Stored NOWHERE: no save field, no roster write; reversion is automatic because nothing was stored.
open_register: the kind's acceptance into #130's vocabulary (this proposal)
whether Strikechamp's unsuited / unsuited_full has any weather relationship (OPEN — its canon fixes existence only)
FROST as a trigger state (FROST is a trace phenomenon in canon, #61 — weather read vs #41 presentation matter is an owner/design question)
